desc: Derive a formal necessary-and-sufficient feasibility condition for a fixed common sum S, including multiplicities, nonnegative complements, and wildcard capacities.
Prove a complete finite set of candidate target sums S, including any large-S interval case not represented by fixed A+B sums.
Design an efficient O(N^2) or better counting method to verify all candidates, considering duplicates.
Analyze edge cases: no unknown values, only unknown A/B values, values requiring negative complements, and duplicates.
Produce a Python implementation with complexity justification and stdin/stdout handling.
